usps: First five-star boutique hotel in the northern Adriatic, just 10 rooms
Each room named after a famous Opatija guest, like James Joyce or Puccini
750+ wine labels curated by top Croatian sommelier Klaudio Jurčić
Restaurant since 1971 with private 70m riva and free SUPs and kayaks
opportunities: No social profiles linked anywhere, despite the site asking guests to share moments. Launch Instagram built around the 10 famous-guest rooms, scampi plates and Amore sunsets over Rijeka's lights.
Klaudio Jurčić is invisible beyond one paragraph. Run monthly 'Cellar with Klaudio' Reels and off-season wine-pairing dinners advertised to Zagreb, Ljubljana and Graz to fill November–March.

Amore Sea Club's 'no dress code, no reservation' Wine&Cork concept needs its own local audience. Geo-targeted Meta ads to Opatija/Rijeka residents promoting aperitivo hours would drive walk-in traffic.

seo.summary: Bevanda has a strong story (since 1971, 10 famous-guest rooms, 750+ wines) and solid basics, but no schema, no canonical and six H1s make it hard for Google to tell hotel, restaurant and sea club apart. The biggest wins are structured data, clean HR/EN/DE signals for Austrian and German guests, and separate local listings for each of the three businesses.

recommendations.fix: Add JSON-LD: Hotel (starRating 5, 10 rooms, amenities like free SUP/kayak), Restaurant (servesCuisine, menu URL, acceptsReservations, foundingDate 1971) and Event markup for weddings and corporate events.

recommendations.issue: Missing canonical and hreflang across HR/EN/DE versions
recommendations.fix: Add a self-referencing canonical on every page plus hreflang tags for hr, en, de and x-default, so Vienna and Munich searches land on the German pages.

recommendations.issue: Hotel, restaurant and Amore compete under one local listing
recommendations.fix: Run three Google Business Profiles: Hotel Bevanda, Restoran Bevanda, Amore Sea Club. Post weekly scampi, wine list and riva sunset photos, and reply to reviews in German and English.

recommendations.issue: No landing pages for weddings, wine and Amore
recommendations.fix: Create dedicated pages for 'Wedding venue Opatija', 'Wine cellar with Klaudio Jurčić' and 'Amore Sea Club Wine&Cork', each 400+ words with FAQs, photos and an inquiry form.

recommendations.issue: Six H1 tags and incomplete Open Graph tags
recommendations.fix: Keep one H1, 'Bevanda Opatija – 5-star boutique hotel and restaurant', and make the rest H2s. Add og:title, og:description and an og:image of the glass dining room at dusk.

seo.suggestedMetaDescription: 10 sea-view rooms named after Joyce and Puccini, fine dining since 1971, 750+ wines and Amore Sea Club on a private riva in Opatija. Book direct.

plan.strategy: With Amore's summer crowd gone, November is about giving Vienna, Munich, Zagreb and Ljubljana reasons to drive to Opatija: Klaudio's cellar, the famous-guest suites and Kvarner scampi. We launch Instagram from zero around these stories, use Martinje on 11 November as the wine hook, and push December corporate dinners and Advent weekends while calendars are still open. Hotel posts get German captions for the Austrian and German markets.
pillars: Famous Guests: heritage stories behind the 10 named rooms

posts.hook: 750 labels. One sommelier. Which bottle meets our scampi?
posts.caption:
Klaudio Jurčić knows Bevanda's cellar like his own handwriting, so he answers this one without blinking.

Kvarner scampi are the sweetest in the Adriatic. They need a wine that steps aside and lets them talk. Watch what he pulls from the shelf 🍷

Our wine story began in 1971. Today it runs to more than 750 labels: rare vintages, proper classics and a few quiet surprises.

Ask for Klaudio when you book. He'll take it from there.
posts.visualIdea: Handheld follow of Klaudio walking the cellar, fingers tracing bottles, pulling one. Cut to scampi plated in the glass dining room, slow pour, Rijeka lights behind. Ends on his nod.
posts.cta: Book a table and ask Klaudio to pour – link in bio.

posts.hook: Puccini has a room in Opatija. So does Joyce.
posts.caption:
Writers, composers, aristocrats, performers: they all chose Opatija. At Bevanda, ten of them have a room named after them.

Swipe to step inside 👉

🎼 Giacomo Puccini Deluxe Suite – king bed, private terrace, separate bedroom and living room
🖋️ James Joyce Deluxe Suite – a jacuzzi view that feels like a yacht deck
🌊 Every room – direct sea view, private terrace, à la carte breakfast

The first five-star boutique hotel in the northern Adriatic. Ten rooms, ten personalities.

Which one would you check into?
posts.visualIdea: Slide 1: Puccini suite terrace at golden hour, name overlay. Next slides: Joyce suite jacuzzi view, door nameplates, terrace breakfast, minibar detail. Final slide: Kvarner Bay seen from the bed.
posts.cta: Tell us your pick in the comments, then book your suite via link in bio.

posts.hook: No dress code. No reservation. Just a glass on the riva.
posts.caption:
Opatija and Rijeka, this one's for you 👋

Amore Sea Club at Bevanda sits on our own 70-metre riva, and it's far less formal than you'd think. Wine&Cork is our new concept: great wines, sparkling by the glass and proper bites, right by the water.

☕ Morning coffee facing Kvarner
🥂 Evening wines and bubbles under the moon

Come straight from work or straight from the beach. Bring friends. Stay as long as the sunset does.
posts.visualIdea: Wide shot of the riva at sunset: two locals in casual summer clothes clinking sparkling wine at the edge, Rijeka lights starting to glow across the bay.
posts.cta: Drop by tonight, no booking needed. Tag who you're bringing.

ads.headline: Sleep in James Joyce's Suite
ads.primaryText: Joyce and Puccini both chose Opatija. At Bevanda, their names are on the door. Just 10 rooms, each with a private sea-view terrace and a hot tub facing Kvarner Bay. Breakfast is à la carte, cooked by a restaurant open since 1971. SUPs and kayaks on our riva are free. The northern Adriatic's first five-star boutique hotel.
ads.audience: Couples aged 35–65 in Vienna, Graz, Munich and Ljubljana interested in luxury travel, boutique hotels and fine wine. Run German and English versions.
ads.budgetTip: Spend most in April–June and September–October, pushing weekend stays when shoulder-season rooms are easiest to fill.

ads.headline: No Dress Code. Just Wine by the Sea
ads.primaryText: Amore Sea Club is open to everyone. No reservation, no dress code, no fuss. Morning coffee on our 70-metre riva, a light snack in the afternoon, sparkling wine under the moon. Try the new Wine&Cork concept from the house that keeps 750+ labels. Same Bevanda, new story. See you on the riva.
ads.description: Amore Sea Club, on Bevanda's riva in Opatija. Walk right in.
ads.audience: Residents aged 25–55 within 15 km of Opatija (Rijeka, Lovran, Matulji, Kastav), plus people currently travelling in Kvarner, interested in wine, aperitivo and beach bars.
ads.budgetTip: Keep it small, €10–15 a day, shown Thursday to Saturday from 4 to 8pm with sunset Reels.
